Iranian financial facilitators Alireza Derakhshan and Arash Estaki Alivand designated for coordinating cryptocurrency transactions on behalf of the IRGC.
Prince Group TCO (Cambodia) and chairman Chen Zhi designated across 146 targets for pig-butchering crypto fraud / forced-labor scam compounds; ~$780M+ BTC attributed (parallel DOJ $15B seizure).
DPRK money-laundering network (Cheil/First Credit Bank, bankers Jang Kuk Chol & Ho Jong Son) designated; 53 crypto addresses (~$5.4M, much frozen by Tether) listed.
Democratic Karen Benevolent Army (Burma) + 4 leaders/companies designated for hosting Chinese-OC pig-butchering crypto scam compounds (Tai Chang near Myawaddy); part of Scam Center Strike Force.
Russian bulletproof-hosting provider Media Land LLC and Aleksandr Volosovik designated (tri-lateral) for enabling ransomware; associated network laundering stablecoins.
